title: Measure indexed mesh area and edge topology
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for vertices (3D metres) and faces (triples of integer vertex indices). Return {"area_m2": sum of triangle areas, "boundary_edges": count, "nonmanifold_edges": count, "degenerate_faces": count}. Triangle area is half the norm of cross(v1-v0,v2-v0); area <=1e-12 marks a degenerate face and its edges are excluded from topology. For other faces count undirected edges by sorted endpoint indices, not coordinate identity. An edge used once is boundary; used more than twice is nonmanifold. Duplicate faces count separately regardless of winding. Empty meshes return zeros. Before calculating anything validate every index; any index outside [0,len(vertices)) returns {"error":"invalid_index"}, including negative indices. Triangle magnitudes fit ordinary double precision. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-9, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
